svg.title: P2-2 Trade-off profile
svg.desc: Generated by make_p2_figures.py (stdlib SVG). Author: Nikhil Prakash (MASc, UBC ECE).
svg.text: 8 systems x 8 trade-off axes. Six ordinal axes: level by POSITION on a Low/Med/High track + word label. Two nominal axes (trust locus, governance) as text. COMPARISON.md §3 (as of 2026-10-31).
Why not a radar: 8 overlapping polygons are unreadable and two axes here are nominal, not numeric; a dot-matrix stays legible and labels every level.

The headline tradeoff (COMPARISON.md §3 T1): S7/S8 remove the live-authority dependency (Availability) and get next-block Revocation freshness, paid for in public linkability (Privacy low), gas Cost, and — for S7 — no Offline

operation and hard Recovery (lost key = lost identity). S5/S6 are the offline, unlinkable, recoverable systems but carry cache-stale revocation. Ordinal levels are a reading of §3's compressed cells + the T1-T4 prose; cells that

needed judgement are listed in FIGURES_P2.md ('Judged / ambiguous'). Position + word label carry the level; the green ring marks the favourable end of each ordinal axis. Nominal axes (trust locus, governance) are text, not ranked.
